title: Advanced Medical Nutrition Therapy
authors: Dr. Sarah Jenkins & Dr. Robert Cole
description: Comprehensive textbook on pathophysiological mechanisms, clinical nutritional assessment, and evidence-based interventions in critical and chronic care.

title: Biochemical & Physiological Aspects of Human Nutrition
authors: Dr. Martha Stipanuk & Dr. Marie Caudill
description: In-depth molecular perspective on carbohydrate, lipid, and amino acid metabolism, cellular signaling, and micronutrient coenzymes.

title: Krause and Mahan's Food & the Nutrition Care Process
description: The gold-standard reference for registered dietitians and students detailing clinical protocols across the lifespan.

title: Modern Food Science and Technology
authors: Prof. David Potter & Dr. Joseph Hotchkiss
description: Explores the principles of food preservation, thermal processing, packaging technologies, and functional ingredient formulation.

title: Clinical Sports Nutrition: Fifth Edition

title: Public Health Nutrition: Principles and Practice in Community and Global Health
description: Frameworks for community intervention design, epidemiological surveillance, food security policies, and behavioral health initiatives.
